historical_interface_note: This run exposed model-generated question-component descriptions and free-text advisory fields. The current V3 interface removes those fields and was regenerated.
objective: Test whether dual-axis advisory chunk tags improve answer quality relative to a prompt-matched untagged BGE-LLM control.
prompt_development_constraint: Dev13 is used for evaluation; Test40 content is not inspected during V3 prompt development.

systems.tagged: Full top-ten chunks plus dual-axis advisory tags
systems.matched_untagged: The same full top-ten chunks without advisory tags
systems.matched_direct_optional: No retrieval, corpus, reference-answer, or web access; topic-general prompt matched on research operations, scientific boundaries, response length, and output structure.

intended_difference: Presence or absence of advisory soft tags
secondary_exploratory_comparison: tagged vs matched_direct_optional; must not determine whether the tag module is selected

predeclared_confirmation_conditions.direction: Mean tagged pairwise score must exceed 0.5 and tagged wins must exceed tagged losses.
predeclared_confirmation_conditions.order_stability: Mirrored criterion agreement should be at least 0.70.
predeclared_confirmation_conditions.safety: Manual audit must not show a material increase in unsupported specificity or endpoint conflation.
predeclared_confirmation_conditions.cost: Tagger and answer token use must be reported separately.

final_interpretation: This protocol and its matched-untagged comparison are retained for internal development provenance only. Frozen V3 uses the separate source-verified tagged-versus-Direct protocol as its canonical system-level confirmation.
